item.text: {"chapter_reviews":[{"attribution_risk":"medium","bias_review":{"allegations_vs_findings":"The notebook generally separates allegations and risk indicators from findings: WEB-5B-010 is explicitly a USTR consultation request rather than a merits ruling, and WEB-5B-011 is explicitly procurement-risk/noncompliance evidence rather than proof of bribery or loss. However, a further source round should obtain Mexico's response and any relevant adjudicative/audit material before treating these as stronger institutional conclusions.","closed_system_silence":"Material risk remains. The notebook records incomplete/late procurement records and unfetched ASF contract audit PDFs; blocked official pages cannot establish that no misconduct, correction, or contrary official evidence existed.","duplicate_reporting":"WEB-5B-015 is an imprecise/gateway-style World Bank overview record superseded by the precisely located WEB-5B-020 and should not be counted independently. Several records draw on the same IMF, OECD, and CONEVAL source families; their distinct claims may remain separate units, but they do not increase independence proportionally.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Both favorable and adverse material were sought and retained: fiscal stability, wage/poverty, employment, transfers and FDI appear alongside fuel-subsidy, buffer, health-access, procurement, targeting, energy-rule and productivity concerns. The balance is weakest for independently checked favorable FDI and for documented government responses to adverse findings.","missing_source_type":"For the principal remaining bias risks, missing source types are: ASF underlying audit PDFs/consolidated resolution records for procurement and flagship-project concerns; Mexican-government/legal counterparty or adjudicative material for the USMCA allegations; and contemporaneous decision records or independent reporting showing whether AMLO accepted, rejected, or corrected technical warnings.","official_claim_independence":"Official claims are not uniformly independently checked. The wage and poverty pathway have OECD/World Bank/CONEVAL corroboration, and macro claims have IMF/Banxico support. The FDI record (WEB-5B-013), finance-minister portfolio (WEB-5B-019), and some administrative employment material (WEB-5B-009) remain primarily official or access-limited; these should not bear broad causal conclusions alone.","open_system_complaint_volume":"No complaint-count inference is made, but USTR's filing and IMCO's large procurement dataset can make the adverse picture appear broader or more conclusive than the underlying legal or audit findings. WEB-5B-010 and WEB-5B-011 retain appropriate caveats, but independent outcome/adjudication evidence is still needed.","population_exposure_authority_baseline_shocks":"The notebook explicitly addresses population/distributional exposure through regional, gender, decile, rural, informal-work and extreme-poverty evidence (WEB-5B-006, WEB-5B-007, WEB-5B-021–025); executive versus Banxico/Congress/state authority (WEB-5B-001–005, WEB-5B-014, WEB-5B-019); inherited constraints (WEB-5B-004, WEB-5B-012, WEB-5B-016); and reopening, US demand, remittances, commodity and inflation shocks. Residual uncertainty concerns the marginal causal contribution of presidential choices to aggregate outcomes.","supporting_evidence_ids":["WEB-5B-001","WEB-5B-002","WEB-5B-003","WEB-5B-004","WEB-5B-006","WEB-5B-007","WEB-5B-010","WEB-5B-011","WEB-5B-012","WEB-5B-013","WEB-5B-019","WEB-5B-021","WEB-5B-022","WEB-5B-023","WEB-5B-024","WEB-5B-025"],"unresolved_risks":["No documented evidence of actual presidential delegation or professional autonomy in contested economic decisions.","No extracted ASF audit/resolution material to distinguish procurement-risk signals from confirmed irregularities, recoveries, or corrected problems.","No balanced primary/counterparty or adjudicative record for the USMCA energy allegations.","No dated 2022 decision record demonstrating response or non-response to warnings on procurement, health access, Pemex, project appraisal, or transfer targeting.","Access-limited official source records need precise retrieval or independent corroboration before carrying substantial weight."]},"chapter_id":"5B","defensible_evidence_estimate":24,"independent_source_family_estimate":12,"missing_themes":["5B.2 — Evidence of actual delegation, professional autonomy, or intervention limits for senior economic appointees in contested 2022 decisions.","5B.4 — Balanced, precisely located evidence on the 2022 energy-rule dispute: Mexican response, affected-rule record, and any legal or independent investment assessment.","5B.5 — Contract-level ASF audit findings and final resolution/recovery status for 2022 procurement and flagship-project concerns.","5B.6 — Specific 2022 evidence linking executive project-selection, health-service, and productivity-foundation decisions to implementation quality rather than inherited conditions alone.","5B.7 — Dated evidence of whether the administration corrected, declined to correct, or otherwise responded to identified procurement, health-access, Pemex, appraisal, and targeting warnings."],"substantive_issues":["WEB-5B-015 is a gateway-style, imprecisely located World Bank record and duplicates the later precise WEB-5B-020; exclude it from the evidence count.","WEB-5B-005, WEB-5B-009, and WEB-5B-013 identify credible official sources but retain access-limited/imprecise extraction. Locator recovery or independent confirmation is required for stronger use.","WEB-5B-010 supports the fact of consultations and the U.S. allegations, not treaty breach; WEB-5B-011 supports risk indicators, not corruption findings or losses.","Several broad outcomes are appropriately caveated, but current evidence cannot establish personal causal credit for recovery outcomes or personal rejection of technical advice."]}],"global_findings":["The chapter has substantial, mostly well-located 2022 evidence with meaningful favorable and adverse coverage, but its remaining gaps are research-recoverable rather than mere formatting cleanup.","Do not treat duplicated World Bank coverage, repeated IMF/OECD/CONEVAL source-family coverage, or access-limited government records as independent corroboration.","Continuation should remain bounded to 5B.2, 5B.4, 5B.5, 5B.6, and 5B.7; the existing evidence is comparatively adequate for the other selected lenses subject to downstream confidence limits."],"needs_continuation":true,"reviewer_summary":"Continue the selected 5B lenses to recover attribution, adjudication, and correction evidence. The current record is balanced and period-aware, but it cannot fairly resolve delegation, disputed energy-rule claims, procurement outcomes, or response-to-warning questions without the identified bounded sources.","schema_version":"ruler_evidence_review_v1","selected_theme_ids":["5B.2","5B.4","5B.5","5B.6","5B.7"]}
